Sample Note

What Makes an API Simple?

When I design an API, I start by writing down one thing the caller needs to do. Then I decide what the API should accept and return. For a request to fetch a record, I specify what comes back when the record exists, when it is missing, and when the request fails.

Ask someone unfamiliar with the implementation to try the API. See if they can handle all three outcomes using a single example.
